entries.name: Stamp duty / transfer duty
entries.statute: Liberia Revenue Code 2000 as amended to 2020 s. 3 (c)-(d) and s. 4 (world/B10-anglophone-africa/lr/law/REVENUE-CODE-LIBERIA-REVENUE-CODE-AMENDEMENT-2020-min.txt); Tax Amendment Acts 2024 and the LRC Amendment of December 2025 (OCR) add no stamp or transfer duty
entries.why: LR: no stamp duty or transfer duty. LRC s. 4 lists the taxes in effect (income tax and royalties, GST, excise, customs duties, real property tax, government agency fees); s. 3 (c)-(d): all changes to taxation are made by amendments to the Code and taxation may not be included in non-tax legislation. Chapter 20 (real property tax) s. 2005 only requires registrars of deeds to report conveyances. Deed registration and probate charges are fees, not modelled.

entries.name: Zakat (as a tax)
entries.why: LR: the general tax code held (REVENUE-CODE-LIBERIA-REVENUE-CODE-AMENDEMENT-2020-min.txt, 742k chars) has no zakat provision (full-text search 'zakat/zakât/zakah')

entries.name: Net wealth tax
entries.why: LR: the general tax code held (REVENUE-CODE-LIBERIA-REVENUE-CODE-AMENDEMENT-2020-min.txt) has no charging provision on net wealth (full-text search 'impôt sur la fortune / le patrimoine', 'patrimoine net'); edition as held, later finance laws not all checked

entries.name: Withholding on interest, dividends and rent paid to residents
entries.classification: duplicate (collection of the personal income tax)
entries.oecdGuide: OECD Interpretative Guide (Revenue Statistics 2026, Annex A; R4/fetch/gap/oecd_guide.txt) §30 ('The way that a tax is levied or collected ... does not affect classification') and §28 (heading 1100)
entries.why: Liberia Revenue Code (as amended 2020) s. 905 (b) (15 % on non-exempt interest and dividends paid to residents) and s. 905 (d) (10 % on rent of 70 000 or more a year) are withholdings with no finality provision in the Code: they are credited against the resident's personal income tax, so the tax is the personal income tax (1100) on that income, computed by the 1.x model, collected in part at source. Not a separate tax.
entries.was: grade C (s. 905(b): 15 % on non-exempt interest and dividends paid to residents; s. 905(d): 10 % on rent where annual rent is 70 000 or more — the Code makes neither withholding final (no finality provision fo)

entries.name: NASSCORP employer contributions (pension 4 % + employment injury 2 %)
entries.statute: Executive Law Chapter 89 (Act approved 27 Dec 2016, published 13 Feb 2017) § 89.16 (a); NASSCORP General Regulations 2023 reg. 15 (rates in Schedule I) (R4/fetch/lr11) [text version: Executive Law Chapter 89 as approved 27 December 2016 and published 13 February 2017; NASSCORP General Regulations 2023 as issued (R4/fetch/lr11)]
entries.doc: § 89.16 (a): 'Contribution rate shall be total 10 % of total gross remuneration of each employee; 2 % under the Employment Injury Scheme payable by the employer; 4 % employer contribution and 4 % employee contribution to be remitted by the employer.'
unsupported: Schedule I of the 2023 Regulations not checked against the Act
